Evidence: Covid vaccination certificates issued in five poll-bound states will not feature Prime Minister Narendra Modi's picture. This decision was made to comply with the Model Code of Conduct as stated by an officer of the health ministry (Source 3). The Election Commission instructed the Union health ministry to remove Modi's image from the certificates before elections in these states (Source 3). Previous instances during assembly elections also showed that Modi's photo was absent from vaccination certificates in poll-bound states (Source 3).
Justification: The retrieved evidence clearly states that vaccination certificates in the five poll-bound states will not feature PM Modi's picture due to the Model Code of Conduct, directly contradicting the claim. Sources indicate that the removal was a compliance measure, not a decision to include his image.
